science_firewall: 13:31 is not an activation time, astronomical solution, physical signal or statistical result.
The conceptual star-shaft illustration is not primary archaeological evidence and does not establish Giza design intent.
The visual adjacency of pyramid and Kamil images does not establish that a pyramid existed at Kamil.
The Kamil crater remains a confirmed impact structure; any archaeological or pre-impact engineered-material interpretation requires independent sample-level evidence.
No LOVE/EDEM coordinate or trajectory is derived from this checkpoint.
This checkpoint must never be used to select dates, azimuths, samples or thresholds post hoc.

current_gate_binding.candidate_rule_summary: Au-Ag-Cu rich + Ni-Co-Ga-Ge not proportionally co-enriched + foil/sheet/seam/solder morphology; stronger if same microdomain also carries Ca-S-Mg or feldspar/granite-style markers beyond local geological controls.
